title: Method for determination of deformation load and breaking load of alpine skis
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11144) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Method for determination of deformation load and breaking load of alpine skis.
clause_3_terminology: Method for determination of deformation load and breaking load of alpine skis

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
